name: Transformations
summary: Fifteen transformations that keep the face: FLUX 3 Klein redraws the photo (statue, bride, cartoon, clones…) and LTX-2.5 morphs the photo into it.

source.notes: The `transitions` workflow (first/last frame + joyfox's transition LoRA) with the last frame made in the graph by the `edit` pipeline (nodes edit:*); the prompt enhancer is off so the motion prompt is used as written. Replaces eleven effect LoRAs (Mona Lisa, VIP, younger self, clones, cartoon jaw drop, assassin, baby, bride, classy, princess, robot face reveal) that lost the person's identity or looked flat at 480p. Ran on an H100 on 23 Oct (20261023-143551-h100): 8 of 9 kept the face; the statue and the aged portrait got their instructions tightened.

sets.value: Repaint this exact person as a Renaissance oil portrait in the pose and setting of the Mona Lisa: seated, hands folded, a misty landscape behind, dark period dress, keeping their own face and features.

The photo slowly turns into an old oil painting: brushstrokes spread across the frame, the background becomes a misty landscape and they settle into a seated pose with hands folded, smiling faintly. {details}
Dress this exact person in elegant black evening wear with gold jewellery, standing on a red carpet at a gala with photographers behind a barricade, keeping their own face.
Camera flashes go off as the scene becomes a red carpet gala; they stand tall and pose for the photographers. {details}
This exact person holding up a phone to take a selfie next to a ten-year-old child version of themselves with the same facial features and hair, both smiling, keeping their own face.
They raise a phone to take a selfie and a child version of themselves appears beside them; both smile at the phone. {details}
Three identical copies of this exact person standing side by side in a row in martial-arts fighting poses, same clothes, same face.
The camera pulls back as they split into three identical copies standing in a row, striking fighting poses. {details}
Redraw this exact person as a classic 2D animated cartoon character with bold outlines and big expressive eyes, keeping their recognisable features and clothes.
The photo turns into a cartoon drawing: outlines appear first, flat colours fill in, then the cartoon blinks and grins. {details}
Turn this exact person into a white marble statue on a stone pedestal in a museum hall: the statue has their exact face, hairstyle, beard if any, pose and clothes, all carved in white marble.
Their skin and clothes slowly turn to white marble from the feet up until they stand still as a statue in a museum hall. {details}
Show this exact person at eighty years old: the same face, gender, hairstyle, expression and clothes, now with grey hair and deep wrinkles.
Time passes: their hair greys and lines deepen as they age gracefully, still smiling at the camera. {details}
Put this exact person in a white spacesuit with the helmet visor open, floating inside a space station with Earth visible through a window, keeping their face.
The room dissolves into a space station; they float gently in a spacesuit while Earth turns outside the window. {details}
Dress this exact person as a stealthy assassin in a dark hooded outfit with leather straps, standing in a misty alley at night, keeping their own face.
A dark hood and leather gear materialise on them as the room fades into a misty night alley; they look up at the camera. {details}
Show this exact person as a one-year-old baby version of themselves with the same facial features and hair colour, sitting in front of a crib surrounded by soft toys.
They shrink and soften into a baby version of themselves in front of a crib, soft toys all around, and giggle. {details}
Dress this exact person in a white lace wedding dress with a veil, holding a bouquet of white flowers, in a flower-filled garden, keeping their own face.
White petals swirl around them as a lace wedding dress and veil appear and a bouquet settles in their hands. {details}
Dress this exact person in elegant light-blue formal wear, holding a small white envelope and a single flower, against a warm gold-brown studio backdrop, keeping their own face.
Warm studio light rises as elegant light-blue formal wear appears on them; they hold up a small envelope and a flower. {details}

Dress this exact person as a fairytale princess with a tiara, a long silver beaded gown and long silver gloves, seated at a table with gifts and candles in a room with white curtains, keeping their own face.
White sparkling light swirls around them; a tiara and a silver gown appear and they sit at a candle-lit table with gifts. {details}
This exact person with the left half of their face opened like a panel to reveal a chrome robot face underneath with a glowing blue eye; the right half is still their own face.
Their face splits down the middle and the left half slides open to reveal a chrome robot face with a glowing blue eye. {details}
Dress this exact person in shining medieval plate armour with the helmet under one arm, standing in a castle courtyard, keeping their face.
Armour assembles around them piece by piece until they stand as a knight in a castle courtyard. {details}
